entries.title: Updater Foundation
entries.detail: LunaAI now has a real desktop update layer with version checks and download-ready release wiring.
notes: Electron can now compare the installed LunaAI version with a published update manifest.
The Updates page is ready to surface a new release and offer a download action.
Download links can be connected later without rebuilding the whole update UI.

entries.title: System Upgrade Pass
entries.detail: Trust layer, action registry, and memory quality were hardened across Luna, Xeno, and the agent flow.
notes: Runtime resource limits now affect real Luna behavior instead of only local UI state.
Project, chat, and gallery flows were aligned into a cleaner shared shell.
Electron desktop identity and internal system layout were refined.
